title: Bab and North East Bab oil well tie-ins: Robt Stone selected for EPC works
project: Bab and North East Bab oil well tie-ins
note: Research 28 Nov: MEED reported on 27 Oct, citing industry sources, that ADNOC Onshore selected Robt Stone Middle East and Jereh Group for the EPC works. The project covers 18 packages with a budget of about $1.2bn. Bidders in May 2026 also included Galfar Emirates, Kalpataru Projects International, Matrix Construction and Target Engineering. Not confirmed by ADNOC. Jereh's share may be the $599m Bab and North East Bab contract in its 12 Nov announcement; that link is unconfirmed.

title: Habshan to Al-Nouf gas pipeline for Ewec: EPC prices submitted in August, main contract reported awarded
project: Habshan to Al-Nouf gas pipeline (Ewec Mirfa relocation and AI data centre)
note: Research 28 Nov: ADNOC Gas tendered this 56-inch, 127km pipeline in mid-April 2026 and received contractor prices by 13 Aug. EPC duration is 31 months from award. It will carry 600-660 million cf/d for AI data centre phase 2 and 650-715 million cf/d for Ewec's Mirfa relocation. An undated MEED item says the main contract was recently awarded; the EPC winner is not named in free sources. The 28 Oct 'local firm wins detailed engineering' report is for this pipeline.

title: Adnoc prepares new wave of oil and gas tenders for 2027: types listed
note: Research 28 Nov: for 2027 ADNOC plans tenders for offshore sour gas developments, an export gas pipeline, enhanced oil recovery projects, refinery residue upgrading, and extra export berths for NGL and sulphur. For 2028: onshore and offshore oilfield developments, an integrated onshore gas project, gas storage, and digitalisation and infrastructure upgrades. Values were not disclosed. The full list was shared at ADNOC's supplier forum.
